9b277b41405a46f4.column_purpose: Result annotation flag: Q marks results at/below the quantitation limit, V and X mark other data-quality/annotation conditions (exact meanings of V, QV, X not defined in this database); blank = no annotation.

951c6114c2ff0262.column_purpose: Code for the food commodity tested (e.g. ST, NE, AP, SP, OG, CU). The specific code-to-commodity mapping is not present in this database, so individual meanings are unresolved.

866708c6daf6b599.column_purpose: Form/type of the commodity: FR = fresh, FZ = frozen, OT = other (e.g. processed).

2bc98850da781239.column_purpose: Measured residue concentration in ppm (see conunit); blank when no quantified value (mean = ND/NP). Values range 0.001-16, median 0.028.

85b1a89ca7038e68.column_purpose: Code for the confirmatory analytical method used (LU, GT, MO); blank when no confirmation performed. Exact method identities not in this database.

99ba645c6a644bab.column_purpose: Second confirmatory method code; entirely empty in this dataset (never populated).

a31302a34b8d4f1d.column_purpose: Unit of concentration; single value 'M' for all rows, consistent with ppm (parts per million).

4a59e817249c91bc.column_purpose: Code for the determinative (quantitative) analytical method (07, 35, 52, 64, 72; values carry trailing CR/LF whitespace). Method identities not in this database.

fba87de16ab60cad.column_purpose: Extraction method code; only 805 and 818 occur, 818 appearing exactly for the 33,705 'OT' commodity-type rows, suggesting 818 is the extraction method for processed/other commodities.

9e327d42e3a3a50e.column_purpose: Code of the analyzing laboratory, state-prefixed (CA1, NY1, WA1, FL1, MI1, OH1, TX1, US2).

366a8ed20e2531db.column_purpose: Limit of detection for the analyte in ppm (0.001-0.5, median 0.005).

5a9f99ef49d44fc9.column_purpose: Result status: ND = not detected (no residue found), NP = test not performed, O = over tolerance/limit, R = (likely) result requiring review or repeat. Exact semantics of O and R not defined here.

194cb3f8e15a3a1e.column_purpose: Code identifying the pesticide/analyte tested (489 distinct, mostly 3-digit numeric codes, some 3-letter codes like AEL, AJY, ALE). Code-to-pesticide mapping not in this database.

67829649e57693d7.column_purpose: Identifier of the tested sample; references sampledata15.sample_pk (many results per sample; 10,187 samples, up to 425 results each).

767792c6783bc708.column_purpose: Code for the class/group of the analytical test panel (A, C, F, I, O, etc.; 20 distinct). Class definitions not in this database.

e891a6cbc170fc40.column_purpose: Claim status code for the sample. 'NC' (no claim) dominates; 'PO', 'OT', 'PP' are other claim categories (exact meanings unresolved, likely price objection / other / price protest in USDA market news reporting).

e2a68459f338f81e.column_purpose: Commodity code (2-letter fruit/vegetable code, e.g. AP apples, GB?, TO tomatoes, CU cucumbers, CB corn, PE peaches, SP spinach).

3b1b7136442716bc.column_purpose: Commodity form/type code: FR = fresh, FZ = frozen, OT = other.

30325cab259dca00.column_purpose: Numeric country code (ISO-like, e.g. 595, 275, 260, 415) for imported produce; blank for domestic (origin=1).

47bfdde25dc00b8a.column_purpose: Day of month (1-31) of the sample date.

909a4be3368383a2.column_purpose: State where the product was distributed; values are US state abbreviations, often with trailing CR/LF characters; blank when not applicable.

4410e6f5c7bb99f0.column_purpose: US state where the commodity was grown; blank for imported product.

7d12e7a2ae3ccfa5.column_purpose: Origin code: 1 = domestic, 2 = imported, 3 = other/unknown origin (small count). Alternative reading: a broader origin/source-type code whose values coincide with domestic/imported in this data.

05138aa2701e35f8.column_purpose: US state where the product was packed; blank when not applicable.

e513cc4c315fab3a.column_purpose: Quantity of the sampled lot (units, likely packages/cartons; 2-62, blank when unknown). Alternative reading: sample weight or number of units collected for testing.

6c741ac18a8e67d7.column_purpose: Primary key; unique sample record identifier, referenced by resultsdata15.sample_pk (one sample to many result rows).

0fa465a0dd93a2e6.column_purpose: Numeric market site code (zero-padded, 312 distinct values) identifying the reporting location/market where the sample was taken.

3dfa2ae44034f55a.column_purpose: US state associated with the sample record (likely the state of the reporting office/market where the sample was collected).

c0ca079616739136.column_purpose: Commodity variety/cultivar name (e.g. Navel, Danjou, Norkotah), with placeholders NA/N/A/Unknown when not specified.

793ea1ecec214f3c.column_purpose: Two-digit year of the sample; all rows are '15' (2015).
